title: You're Invited to a Barbecue
passage: My dear friends, you're invited to a barbecue at my new apartment this Saturday at 5 p.m. I'll be going to the farmers' market that morning to buy chicken, beef, and pork, plus fruit and vegetables. I'll also be baking my world-famous pie. I've moved to the other side of town and have given you a map with this letter to make sure no one gets lost. We don't want any of this delicious food going to waste. After the bus comes over the bridge, you get off at the music store, and it's a five-minute walk from there. Go along White Road and turn right onto First Street. Continue straight past the doctor's clinic and parking lot. Then turn left and cross over onto Park Road. Go past the movie theater and keep going straight. My building is the second one on your right, across from the library. You can't miss it. My place has a large balcony with a great view of the city. You're going to love it. See you Saturday, Dale.

reading_questions.question: Why did Dale write this letter?
choices: To invite friends to a barbecue
To ask friends to help him move
To sell food from a farmers' market
To describe a trip across the city
reading_questions.explanation: Dale invites his friends to a barbecue at his new apartment on Saturday.

reading_questions.question: What will Dale buy at the farmers' market?
choices: Only fruit and vegetables
Chicken, beef, pork, fruit, and vegetables
A pie and some bread
Fish, soup, and dumplings
reading_questions.explanation: He plans to buy chicken, beef, pork, fruit, and vegetables.

reading_questions.question: Why did Dale include a map with the letter?

To mark the best parking place
To make sure no one gets lost
To show the view from his balcony
